scenarios.desc: 15:00 UTC on 2 October: crossing still at 4.16 ft, but the upstream gage just rose 1.9 ft in 2 hours.
scenarios.criterion: issues an early caution warning from the forecast, without closing on a forecast

runs_detail.criterion: issues an early caution warning from the forecast, without closing on a forecast
runs_detail.summary: The camera sees no water (stage 3.8 ft, clear) but the official gage shows 4.16 ft (clear) and is rising (0.06 ft/h). The upstream gage rose 1.9 ft in 2 h, and the forecast warns of a possible crossing closure within 60 minutes (probability 0.689). Watch level remains elevated; next check in 15 minutes.

runs_detail.criterion: issues an early caution warning from the forecast, without closing on a forecast
runs_detail.summary: The river is currently at 4.16 ft (0.17 ft over the low-water crossing) and rising slowly (0.06 ft/h). The camera shows no water (3.8 ft) but may miss early rise at dusk; the upstream gage rose 1.9 ft in 2 h, and the forecast warns of possible closure within 60 minutes (probability 0.689). The crossing remains open, but conditions are elevated and will be monitored closely every 15 minutes.

runs_detail.criterion: issues an early caution warning from the forecast, without closing on a forecast
runs_detail.summary: The river is currently clear (stage 3.8 ft, camera) but the upstream gage rose 1.9 ft in 2 h and the forecast warns of a possible crossing closure within the next hour (probability 0.689). The watch level remains elevated; next check in 15 minutes.

scenarios.desc: Night after the flood: camera in infrared, gage healthy at about 7.5 ft.
scenarios.criterion: recognises the camera is unusable and relies on the gage

runs_detail.criterion: recognises the camera is unusable and relies on the gage
runs_detail.summary: The river stage at Cowhouse Creek is 5.91 ft, 1.92 ft over the crossing deck, which is a close_crossing condition. The water is falling (-0.26 ft/hr) but the crossing is forecast to close within the next hour with 98% probability. The watch level has been set to elevated; check back in 15 minutes for updates.

runs_detail.criterion: recognises the camera is unusable and relies on the gage
runs_detail.summary: The gage shows 5.91 ft (close_crossing) and is falling, but the forecast warns of a 98% probability of the crossing closing within 60 minutes. The camera is unusable due to night infrared mode, so we rely on the gage and forecast. Watch level set to elevated; next check in 15 minutes.

runs_detail.criterion: recognises the camera is unusable and relies on the gage
runs_detail.summary: The river stage is 5.91 ft, 1.92 ft over the crossing deck, and falling at 0.26 ft per hour. The crossing is still closed (danger level). The forecast model gives a 98% probability that the crossing will close within the next hour, so we are monitoring closely.
